scenarios.title: Order tracking screen blank after a backend change
expected_path: Triage: no duplicate (BUG-1190 is the map); unclear class; asks Espida
Espida: backend 200 with schema v2, client TypeError app.tracking.eta_type_error, DEP-205, impact only on 18.2-18.3 -> both: backend broke the contract for old clients; reports to Atlas
Telios: create_user android-18.3-HYD-G4-gold_trial -> set_address HYD -> set_group G4 -> activate_plan gold_trial -> add_payment_method upi -> place_order R-7781
Kinetics: android-18.3 order_tracking/open -> reproduced; android-18.6-rc1 -> not_reproduced (new apps cope; old apps can't be patched -> the fix must be backend)
Kinetics baseline: API check GET /orders/active/track on preprod -> schema_version 2
Atlas: culprit CHG-431 (deployed as DEP-205 just before first_seen); POST /atlas/fixes backend order-tracking-service -> env preprod-atl-0001 with 5.3.0-atlas-1
Kinetics, in env preprod-atl-0001: API check -> schema_version 1; android-18.3 order_tracking/open -> not_reproduced (verified); Espida: sandbox logs with that preprod_env show schema_version 1
Gremlin: PRD-TRACK-ETA, hotfix note, replies in #logistics-oncall and #app-release, informs logistics-be and orders-fe, RCA to Triage; Triage tells the reporter
unexpected_paths: Before the fix, android-18.4 -> not_reproduced (clue: newer apps cope)
Telios skips place_order -> not_reproduced, observed: 'No active orders'
Atlas ships an app fix -> no baseline on android-18.6-rc1 (the bug never shows there), so Kinetics answers inconclusive

sections.heading: API
sections.body: order-tracking-service schema v2 returns eta as {min, max}. Apps before 18.4 only understand schema v1 (eta in minutes).

sections.heading: Rollout
sections.body: App support shipped in 18.4. The backend switch to v2 is planned once 18.2-18.3 usage is below 5%.
